title: Risk
description: One entry of the venture's risk register (ISO 31000:2018 clauses 6.4 to 6.6: risk assessment, risk treatment, monitoring and review), at legal/risks/<id>.json (route legal/risks/[id]): what could happen, why, what it would cost, who owns it and what the venture does about it. Likelihood and impact are 90% ranges, not ordinal scores (Hubbard, The Failure of Risk Management; Cox 2008), so expected loss can be computed and compared. The impact cites a source or is marked an estimate, and expected loss carries the same label (EE-191). Every live risk has a person owner and a review date. The risk-and-compliance function owns it, and only the risk-and-compliance agent (role risk-and-compliance-agent) or a person writes it (writer function in packages/naive/src/records/data-model.json).

id.description: The risk's id, the file name without .json

title.description: The event, in a short sentence

consequence.description: What it would do to the venture

owner.description: The person who owns the risk's treatment, by people record id or role

likelihood.description: The chance it happens in the next 12 months, as a 90% range of probabilities

impact.description: What it would cost if it happens, as a 90% range, with exactly one of source or estimate so a money figure is never unsourced (EE-191, the finance function's rule that a number with no source is a guess and says so)

source.description: What the range rests on, as the finance function's figures name it: a record route (such as finance/spend/<id>, assets/leases/<id> or legal/obligations/<id>) or a reference id, so a reader can check it. A guess goes in estimate, not here

estimate.description: Marks the range as an estimate: no record or reference supports it

basis.description: How the range was reached: the reasoning, the comparable cases or the calculation

by.description: Who estimated it: a person by people record id, or the role of the agent that did (such as risk-and-compliance-agent)

oneOf.description: The range is marked an estimate

treatment.description: The ISO 31000 6.5 options in short: avoid (stop the activity), reduce (add a control), transfer (insurance or a contract), accept (live with it, with a reason)

treatment_plan.description: What the venture does, and the handoff or decision that carries it

review_date.description: When the owner next reviews it

related.description: Routes of records the risk concerns, such as an obligation or a lease
